build.source_scope: 26 recovered modules compiled during this audit; original 70 verified module sources and pinned dependencies reused. The final successful build reuses outputs from earlier port attempts after compatibility fixes. No compiler or Mathlib upgrade.

proof_size_scope.full_certificate_lower_bound: For N>=16, every valid InitialCertificate N player dag has at least 2^((N-2)/12) listed nodes, with natural division. This is not a lower bound on arbitrary Lean proofs.
proof_size_scope.supporting_mathematics: Certificate format, checker soundness, covering lemmas, game-aware deletion lemmas and the high-counter argument are included in the recovered dependency closure.
proof_size_scope.generation_search_cost: Historical research cost not measured; this audit replays existing proofs rather than claiming discovery or a new proof-size lower bound.

hosted_verification.this_update: Runs independently after push; not yet a hosted result at receipt creation.

limits: Collection/source checks have bounded subprocess deadlines; the explorer defaults to 10 seconds, 200000 states and <=20 counters, and reports incomplete without an outcome on resource exhaustion.
mathematical_status: C remains open. The 26 recovered modules are existing work, now replayed in the collection. Raw archive sources and old native-only outcome claims are not current verified results. The cryptid definition/equivalence source files are unchanged.
